name: @mm/root
description: A fantasy eShop making use of AWS services as a learning exercise.

scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm --filter @mm/ui build && pnpm --filter @mm/infra cdk deploy "MaloMartDev/*" --outputs-file ../local/cdk-outputs.json && pnpm --filter @mm/api env:dev
scripts.deploy:dev:backend: pnpm --filter @mm/infra cdk deploy "MaloMartDev/*" -c skipFrontend=true --outputs-file ../local/cdk-outputs.json && pnpm --filter @mm/api env:dev
scripts.deploy:frontend: pnpm --filter @mm/ui build && pnpm --filter @mm/infra cdk deploy MaloMartDev/MaloMartFrontendStack
